headline: Foreign investors were net buyers of Brazilian stocks in October
summary: Non-resident investors bought approximately $4.2 billion net in Brazilian equities in October, despite post-election selling pressure, according to the Institute of International Finance.
why: Cross-border capital flows into emerging market equities serve as an important gauge of global investor appetite for Latin American risk assets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Net foreign equity inflows provide underlying support for Brazilian asset prices.
